To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the demographic variables of gender, age, income, education and occupation are not significant factors that influence the intention to buy organic food products among consumers in Klang Valley.
consumers in Klang Valley are more willing to purchase organic food if they are aware of the benefits that organic food has over conventional food and if organic food is more affordable.
organic food products are perceived to be healthy, tasty, and better for environment, but consumers are still not willing to buy organic food products due to the higher price.

the factors influencing consumers’ purchase intention of organic products and demographic characteristics.
the demographic characteristics of consumers and their intention to purchase organic foods.
the demographic characteristics of consumers who are more likely to consume organic food products and factors that influence consumers’ purchase intention of organic food.

the consumers in Klang Valley are aware of the benefits of organic food and the majority of them are willing to purchase the products.
the consumers’ intention to buy organic food products is highly influenced by their perception on the product and its worth of purchase.
the intention to buy organic food products is influenced by the perception of organic food worth of purchase, safety and health aspects and the demographic characteristics.

the intention of the consumers to purchase organic food is heavily influenced by the belief on the health aspect of the organic product and the worth of purchase of the product.
